clips.title: The story
paras: In Deathknell, a newly awakened Forsaken paladin begins training with the Light. After facing the undead outside the crypt, you are sent to the village church to meet Aramis Hammerhand and learn what holy power demands of the Forsaken.

After you clear feral undead from outside the crypt, Shadow Priest Sarvis gives you an unexpected delivery. The Consecrated Scroll shines with holy energy, and Sarvis recoils before asking you to step aside. For one devoted to shadow and decay, the Holy Light burns like an open flame.

Aramis Hammerhand waits inside Deathknell’s desecrated church to train Forsaken paladins. Other races may wield the Light with ease and joy, but the undead endure searing agony when they call upon it. Aramis speaks plainly: channeling holy power through a rotting body is torment. He expects his disciples to face that pain instead of shrinking from it, and let it temper their resolve.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine its of some importance to a paladin like yourself.
Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your training can now begin in earnest, paladin. I see great promise in you, but take care not to turn away from the light, even for a moment. Embrace the pain it will cause you. That pain is a crucible, and you will emerge from it stronger than you ever were in your previous life.
